text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — planning a 48h holiday micro-burst for MQL push (search + retargeting). Goal: +20% MQLs with flat CPA. Need creative refresh + tight budget pacing. Thoughts?

Alex Rivera: Love it. Proposed setup: split-test two creative angles (Discount vs ROI), three geo buckets (US, CA, UK), dayparting on PST peak (9a-9p). Recommend canary first 2h. What CPA target are we locking to?

Priya Singh: Target CPA = $45 for webinar signups. Recommend retargeting windows: 1d high-intent (cart/checkout), 7d warm, 14d broad. Keep lookback short for this push to maximize lift. Ops: can we get landing variant B live?

Nate O'Connor: Landing B is ready (short hero, 1-step form). I'll wire GA events and conversion ping. Also suggest soft max CPC caps on top keywords to prevent spend spikes. Sample UTM template I'm going to use:
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=holiday_microburst_2023&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative_variant}
```
Make sure the final UTM keys match the Looker joins.

ads-bot: Account check -> daily_cap: $8500, spare_today: $3200. Proposal: ramp schedule 25% -> 50% -> 100% over first 6 hours; rollback if CPA > $60 for 30m. Canary channel created.

Maya Chen: Schedule idea: start 2023-12-15 00:00 PST, run 48h. Canary for top 3 keywords first 2hrs, then open. Can everyone confirm ownership?

Priya Singh: I'll own audience lists + retarget windows. Will export and share segments by 11:00 AM PT. I'll also set the 1d high-intent list to exclude users who converted in the last 24h.

Alex Rivera: I'll own creatives and copy. Drafts ready, posting into #ads-creative for review in 15. We'll have creative A (discount) and creative B (time-limited value).

Nate O'Connor: I'm on GA events and landing QA. Quick note: use event name `microburst_signup` exactly — Looker expects that. Also adding a tiny 200ms delay on form redirect to ensure event fires.

Priya Singh: Canary rules: top 3 keyword groups at 25% for 2hrs, measure CTR, conv rate, CPA. If conv rate +30% vs baseline and CPA <= $45, escalate to 50%.

Alex Rivera: Small ask — can we try an alternate CTA for one geo? eg "Save your seat" vs "Register now" to see which performs better on creative B.

Maya Chen: Good call. Alex take the UK geo variant. Priya make sure audiences are clean for that geo. Nate — double-check timezone routing on the landing.

ads-bot: Update: staging campaign created id=987654321, canary live at 25%. Monitoring alerts set for CPA and spend velocity.

Nate O'Connor: No blockers from infra. One thing — confirm GCLID -> event mapping in GA; if not, conversion attribution will be skewed.

Priya Singh: Confirmed, GCLID passthrough enabled. Exported audience CSV to #ads-ops.

Alex Rivera: Creative posted to #ads-creative. Need sign-off by 10:30 to hit schedule.

Maya Chen: Great. Tagged owners: @Alex Rivera @Priya Singh @Nate O'Connor. :thumbsup: Sync 20m before launch for final checks. We'll debrief 48h after burst and pull microburst_lift_v1 metric in Looker. Any blockers?

Alex Rivera: None.

Priya Singh: None.

Nate O'Connor: None.

ads-bot: Reminder scheduled 30m before launch. Will post live metrics every 15m to the thread.

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks team. Let’s keep CPA stable and maximize qualified signups.
